_source: USDA NAIP 2023-09-25 (co_m_3910409_se_13_030_20230925, z18, tracks/sand-creek/source/naip_2023_sc_z18.jpg): one tree per crown read off the photograph (tools/plan_bespoke_vegetation.py place crowns, ledger 0079); positions and crown widths measured, heights from the width by an [invented] ratio, species by patch size [invented threshold]
_doc: Ledger 0079 (Kevin 2026-11-04: Sand Creek's trees from measured positions, no invented scatter). Replaces Sand Creek's grid-with-jitter plan (tracks/sand-creek/source/bespoke/trees.plan.json: an 11 m grid, 3.5 m random jitter, 45 % random interior keep) with the crowns mode, and the colour rule re-read on the z18 scene (_rule_doc).
_rule_doc: re-read on this z18 scene (ledger 0079): sampled sunlit crowns read mean 66-83, g/r 1.19-1.37, g/b 1.26-1.73, excess green 44-54; a dark lawn g/r 1.08, a street g/r 1.07 and mean 116, a dirt lot g/r 0.96; the old z16 rule (g/r 1.02, g/b 1.1) took lawns, lots and the crowns' shadows as canopy

crowns._doc: min_crown_m2: a 3 m crown (smaller blobs are shrubs or shadow); smooth_m / min_sep_m: two tops closer than 3.5 m are one crown; max_radius_m: a 14 m crown, a big plains cottonwood; wood_near: a crown within 60 m of a mapped creek (OSM waterway, source/bespoke/waterways.osm.json) is the riparian wood, cottonwood [the 60 m is invented]; w_over_h: the old plan's species ratios (cottonwood 0.85, street tree 0.8) [invented]
